Reasoning: This release stage keeps the current panda_fingertip pose fixed while opening the gripper. freeze_position fixes the panda_fingertip origin at its start-of-stage position within 0.01 m. freeze_orientation fixes the panda_fingertip start-of-stage orientation using the available fixed-orientation operator. open_gripper commands the fingers to open and represents success via the gripper_opened condition. The API has no explicit term for gripper joint target value 1.0, finger effort dropping to free-space, or absence of object_grasped contact during release, so those feedback details are omitted rather than encoded as arm manipulator effort.
